title: Buyumlar: a / an
hook_voice: Lesson thirteen. A pen, an apple, an egg.
hook_say: Inglizchada buyum nomi oldiga nima qo'yiladi?

example.en: This is a book. That is an apple.

end_say: Saqlab qo'ying! Ertaga o'n to'rtinchi dars: ko'plik.
caption:
0 dan ingliz tili, 13-dars: inglizcha «a» va «an».

This is a pen — Bu ruchka
This is an apple — Bu olma
This is an egg — Bu tuxum

Undosh tovush oldidan a (a pen, a book), unli tovush oldidan an (an apple, an egg).
Saqlab qo'ying va ingliz tilini boshlamoqchi bo'lgan do'stingizga yuboring.
Ertaga 14-dars: Ko'plik.
